capabilities: Plan notes or selections into structured goal cards
Auto-dispatch daily tasks from goal sub-items
Award bamboo coins and log timeline on completion
Level cultivation realms across 10 stages and 100 layers
Run deep reviews with health score and action plans
disambiguation: Not a theme or sound pack; the bamboo ambience and cultivation narrative are decoration around a goal-to-daily-task automation pipeline.
extras: One-time buyout (¥69 early-bird, ¥9999 regular); unactivated plugin shows a full-screen gate. Paid users get expert consultations, a private community, and free theme drops; activation code is device-portable via backup code.
problem: Obsidian has no self-running loop from vague intent to daily tasks and progress feedback, so breaking goals down and tracking follow-through stays manual.

relations.evidence: AI runs on your own API Key (DeepSeek by default, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint supported)

requires.name: One-time purchase via WeChat Pay with personal activation code
AI API key (DeepSeek or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

summary: Chinese-style goal automation system that turns notes into structured goals, dispatches daily tasks, and rewards completion with coins and cultivation realms.
